name: The Five Blades — The Final Battle

combat_intro.title: The Road to the Volcano
combat_intro.narrator: The Chaos grows. The road climbs.
combat_intro.text:
You feel the heat before you see the volcano.

The air changes.
Heavier.
Charged.

Like before a storm.

Except there are no clouds.

Your black blade trembles in its sheath.

It has been doing that all night.

You did not sleep.

choices.text: Look at the four before leaving.

regard_matin.title: Morning
regard_matin.text:
They pack their things in silence.

Ikar checks his blade.
Aryn packs with care.
Taera tightens the pouch around her neck.
Vael isn't whistling.

That silence.

You have known them for a few weeks.

Long enough to know this silence is different.

They are afraid.

Not of you.

For you.

It's different.

And it's worse.

pourquoi_volcan.title: Why Here
pourquoi_volcan.text:
Aryn walks beside you.

**"The Chaos needs a point of release."**
**"A place strong enough to absorb what's going to come out."**

**"And if it overflows?"**

She looks at the volcano in the distance.

**"The volcano has been molten for centuries."**
**"It has seen worse."**

Vael slips between the two of you.

**"Very reassuring way of putting it."**

**"I know."** Aryn says.

She doesn't try to take it back.

It's the first time.

choices.text: Ask Aryn what she really thinks.

aryn_vrai_pense.title: What She Really Thinks
aryn_vrai_pense.text:
She thinks for a long time.

**"I think you're going to make it."**

**"And do you believe it?"**

Silence.

**"I want to."**
**"Strongly enough for it to matter."**

She looks at you.

**"Caël had no one who wanted it for him."**
**"That's when everything changed."**
**"Not in the battle."**
**"Before."**

She resumes walking.

**"We're here."**
**"That's what's different."**

montee_debut.title: The Climb
montee_debut.narrator: The ground is warm under your feet.
montee_debut.text:
The path climbs.

Narrow.
Rocky.
Every step on black stone.

Old lava, hardened, forms walls on both sides.
Rivers frozen in place.
Caught mid-flow.

Your blade vibrates harder with every meter.

As if it recognizes the place.

Or what is coming.

montee_silence.title: The Silence of the Climb
montee_silence.text:
You walk.

Just walking.

The heat.
The dull rumble of the volcano.
The crunch of rock underfoot.

In your head — Cendral.

Mira's bakery.
The low wall of the square.
Old Marek and his carving knife.

The knife is still at your belt.

You touch it.

It's warm.

Everything is warm here.

But this — this comes from somewhere else.

montee_taera.title: Taera
montee_taera.text:
Taera touches the rock as she walks.

Her fingers slide over the black surface.

**"The earth suffers here."**

**"For a long time?"**

**"Forever."**
**"It's its natural state."**

She pulls her hand back.

**"Some places are born to burn."**
**"That doesn't make them any less real."**

She looks at you.

**"You were born to carry the Chaos."**
**"That doesn't make you any less yourself."**

She resumes walking.

**"The earth knows it."**
**"Even here."**

montee_vael.title: Vael
montee_vael.text:
Vael walks beside you.

He tries to whistle.

The hot air warps the sound.

He stops.

**"Even my music doesn't work here."**

**"That's a bad sign."**

**"Probably."**

He looks at the lava below.

**"I searched all night for a joke for today."**
**"All night."**

**"And?"**

**"Nothing."**

He smiles.
Differently than usual.

**"Which proves it's serious."**
**"Because I always find a joke."**
**"Always."**

**"Except today."**

montee_ikar.title: Ikar
montee_ikar.text:
Ikar is in front.

Always.

You speed up.

He hears you.
He doesn't slow down.
He doesn't turn around.

**"Ikar."**

Nothing.

**"I know about last night."**

He stops.

Long silence.

**"I wanted you to know..."**

**"No."** he says.

**"No?"**

**"You don't have to tell me you understand."**
**"Or that you forgive."**
**"You owe me nothing."**

He turns around.

**"I have to be here."**
**"Today."**
**"That's all I can do."**

He starts walking again.

More slowly this time.

montee_aryn.title: Aryn — The Last Word
montee_aryn.text:
Aryn walks at your pace.

She isn't looking at the summit.

She is looking at you.

**"Do you remember what Lyra told me?"**

**"No."**

**"That doubt is water."**
**"It goes around."**
**"It waits."**
**"It eventually finds its way."**

She pauses.

**"The Chaos finds its way too."**
**"The question is which one."**

**"And what if I choose the wrong one?"**

She looks at you.

For a long time.

**"Then we will have been here anyway."**
**"And that will count."**
**"Even if you don't remember it."**
**"We will have been here."**

avant_sommet.title: Before the Summit
avant_sommet.text:
Fifty meters.

You stop.

The lava is visible all around.
The sky a deep red.
The summit smoking.

The four form a half circle behind you.

Taera clutches her pouch.
Vael closes his eyes for a second.
Aryn rests her hand on her sword — not to draw it.
Just to feel that it is there.

Ikar.

Ikar looks at you.

**"You're not Caël."** he says.

Just that.

**"You're not Caël."**

You nod.

You climb.

sommet_arrive.title: The Summit
sommet_arrive.narrator: From up here, the world is immense.
sommet_arrive.text:
The natural platform at the top.

Lava in a ring.
The sky red and black.
The hot wind.

You stop.

Your blade.

It no longer vibrates.

It roars.

A sound you don't hear with your ears.

With your bones.

The Chaos recognizes this place.

It wants out.

**"Hold on."** Aryn says.
**"Just a little longer."**

Her voice breaks on the last word.

Too late.

chaos_explose.title: The Explosion
chaos_explose.text:
The black blade explodes.

Violet light in every direction.

The ground cracks around you.

The four step back.

Ikar raises his blade — it lights up.
Aryn summons a wall of water between herself and the Chaos.
Taera plants her sword — a wall of rock rises.
Vael vanishes into the air.

**"{{player}}!"** Taera shouts.

You cannot answer.

The Chaos speaks in your place.

And the four —

The four find themselves facing what they have spent their whole lives preparing for.

None of them backs down.

Not one of them.

The battle begins.

combat_action1.title: Ikar
combat_action1.narrator: The Chaos flows through you. You no longer control anything.
combat_action1.text:
Ikar charges first.

Of course.

It's Ikar.

His burning blade traces an arc of fire through the hot air.

Direct.
No detours.
As always.

The Chaos in you sees him coming.

Violet energy gathers in your right hand.

You have one second.

Only one.

Strike.
Or hold back.

choices.text: Hold back — channel the energy into the lava.

ikar_frappe.title: Ikar Struck
ikar_frappe.text:
The violet energy hits Ikar square in the chest.

He flies backward.

Five meters.

He slams into the rock.

His blade goes out.

Silence.

He doesn't move.

One second.

Two.

Taera screams his name.

Ikar gets up.

Slowly.
Very slowly.

He looks at his dead blade.

He grips the hilt.

It flares back to life.

Small.
Trembling.
But there.

He looks at you.

**"Again."**

His voice doesn't tremble.

His hands do.

He steps forward anyway.

ikar_retenu.title: Held Back
ikar_retenu.text:
The energy goes into the lava.

It absorbs it with a hiss.

The lava rises a meter.

Falls back.

Ikar stops a breath away from you.

His burning blade between you.

He looks you in the eyes.

**"You held back."**

**"Yes."**

Something in his face.

Not relief.

Resolve.

**"Once more."** he says.

He steps back.

He waits for what comes next, with you.

entre_actions_1.title: Between the Waves
entre_actions_1.text:
The Chaos pulses.

Like a heart.

Each beat sends a wave of energy out.

You are at the center.

You see everything.

Aryn holding her water shield — steam rising.
Taera holding her rock wall — her arms trembling.
Vael somewhere in the air — you hear him without seeing him.
Ikar standing — his blade refusing to go out.

They are holding on.

All four of them.

For you.

combat_action2.title: Vael
combat_action2.text:
Vael reappears.

Behind you.

He tries to wrap his arms around you.

Not to hurt you.

To steady you.

The Chaos senses someone at its back.

It reacts.

Before you can decide.

choices.text: Let it happen — release the energy.

vael_frappe.title: Vael Struck
vael_frappe.text:
The energy explodes outward in a circle.

Vael is thrown.

He lands at the edge of the platform.

Right at the edge.

His hands grip the rock.

He doesn't fall.

But he doesn't get up right away.

He stays there.
Hands on the rock.
Head bowed.

Taera runs toward him.

He raises a hand.

*I'm here.*

Then he turns back to you.

His usual smile.

But his eyes —

His eyes are not smiling.

**"I knew you weren't a monster."**

Just that.

He gets up.

He takes his position again.

vael_retenu.title: Steadied
vael_retenu.text:
The energy goes into the lava.

Vael holds you.

His hands on your arms.

The air around you swirls.

**"There."** he says in your ear. **"Like that."**

**"Do you have a joke now?"**

**"I'm looking for one."**
**"Give me thirty more seconds."**

Despite everything.

Despite the volcano.
The lava.
The Chaos.

You laugh.

Just for a second.

It's enough.

entre_actions_2.title: The Volcano Answers
entre_actions_2.text:
The ground shakes.

The volcano answers the Chaos.

Lava climbs the edges of the platform.

Aryn shouts something.

You cannot hear the words.

But you see her face.

Not fear.

Determination.

She tightens her shield around you.

Water vapor against the heat of the lava.

It holds.

For how much longer?

combat_action3.title: Aryn
combat_action3.text:
Aryn steps into the Chaos.

Not with her blade.

With her hands open.

She creates a corridor of water between you.

Cold.
Calm.
Impossible here.

But real.

**"Look at me."** she says.

The Chaos presses against the corridor.

Aryn steps back one pace.

She holds.

**"Look at me."**

aryn_frappe.title: Aryn Struck
aryn_frappe.text:
The Chaos breaks the corridor.

The water explodes into scalding steam.

Aryn is thrown backward.

She falls.

Ikar is there in two steps.

He catches her before she hits the ground.

He looks at her.

**"Aryn."**

**"I'm here."** she says.

Her voice is steady.

Her burned hands are not.

She gets back on her feet.

She looks at her palms.

**"Water doesn't scream."**

She rebuilds the corridor.

Smaller.

With her hands trembling.

But she rebuilds it.

aryn_retenu.title: In the Corridor
aryn_retenu.text:
You look at her.

The Chaos recedes.

Not by much.

But enough.

In the cold corridor of water —

A moment outside the Chaos.

**"Do you remember Cendral?"** Aryn says.

**"Yes."**

**"That's who we're doing this for."**
**"Not for the prophecy."**
**"Not for the Order."**
**"For the people who live in the Cendrals of the world."**

The corridor closes.

The Chaos returns.

But something stays.

avant_taera.title: The Last Wall
avant_taera.narrator: The lava rises. The platform shrinks.
avant_taera.text:
The platform cracks.

The lava advances along the edges.

Perhaps ten meters of stable rock remain.

The four are here.

Wounded.
Exhausted.
Still standing.

The Chaos keeps pouring out.

It won't stop on its own.

Something is needed.

Or someone.

Taera plants her sword in the rock.

She takes something from her pouch.

The seed she picked up the morning you set out.

She holds it in her palm.

Then she moves forward.

moment_taera.title: Taera
moment_taera.narrator: The world shrinks to this platform.
moment_taera.text:
She walks into the Chaos.

Her clothes burn at the edges.

She does not stop.

The heat of the lava behind her.
The Chaos ahead.

She keeps walking.

Her hair catches fire, just a little.

She does not stop.

Her hands bleed wherever the Chaos touches them.

She.
Does.
Not.
Stop.

She is a meter away.

Her eyes.

**"{{player}}."**

Your name.

**"I'm here."**

She opens her hand.

The seed in her palm.

**"The earth says you can."**

Her hand outstretched.

taera_main_prise.title: The Hand
taera_main_prise.text:
You take her hand.

The seed between your two palms.

Earth against the Chaos.

Something changes.

The violet energy does not vanish.

It gathers.

Like water finding its bed.
Like fire finding its hearth.
Like air finding its direction.
Like earth finding its root.

Taera squeezes your hand.

Ikar arrives on your left.
His burning blade against your shoulder.
Warm.
Real.

Aryn on your right.
Her water shield encircling all five.

Vael behind.
The wind swirling.

Five.

For the first time, truly five.

**"Now."** Aryn says.

The Chaos pours out.

All of it.

Toward the volcano.

The lava rises twenty meters.

The violet light vanishes into the lava.

Silence.

True silence.

apres_combat.title: After
apres_combat.text:
You look at your hands.

The black blade is there.

It no longer vibrates.
It no longer absorbs.

It is simply there.

Cold.

As always.

You look up.

The four are on their feet.

Some barely.

But standing.

All four of them.

Vael sits down abruptly on the rock.

**"Well."** he says.
**"It's done."**

**"Is that all you have to say?"** Ikar asks.

**"I found a joke."**
**"But the timing is bad."**
**"I'll save it for later."**

Ikar looks at him.

He shakes his head.

But something in his face.

Something like a smile.

Almost.

evaluer_degats.title: The Cost
evaluer_degats.text:
Ikar sits.

His hand on his chest where you struck him.
Or not.

Vael holds his side.
Or not.

Aryn tends to her burned hands.
Or not.

Taera is beside you.
The seed still in her palm.

You look at it.

She opens her hand.

The seed is intact.

**"I'll plant it where we build."** she says.
**"Somewhere."**
**"Where something needs to grow."**

Ikar lifts his eyes to you.

He says nothing.

He taps the rock twice with his fist.

The way his father used to tap the anvil.

*Good.*

fin_victoire_complete.title: Ending — The Storm Has Passed
fin_victoire_complete.text:
The sun rises over the volcano.

Red first.
Then orange.
Then yellow.

You go down together.

Slowly.

No one speaks for a long time.

Then Taera:

**"The earth suffers less here."**

**"Since when?"**

**"Since that night."**

You touch the knife at your belt.

Marek's.

Still warm.

Still warm.

Vael finally starts whistling.

It works better on the way down.

Ikar walks in front.
As always.

But he waits at the turns.

Aryn walks beside you.

**"What are you thinking about?"**

**"Cendral."**
**"The low wall of the square."**
**"Mira and her bread."**
**"Luc and his broken baguette."**

**"They'll rebuild."**

**"I know."**

**"And you?"**

You look at the black blade.

It absorbs the morning light.

Cold.

**"Me too."**

fin_victoire_blessures.title: Ending — At the Cost of Blood
fin_victoire_blessures.text:
The descent is slow.

Some limp.
Some lean on the others.

You look at their wounds.

Wounds you caused.

Vael sees you looking.

**"Stop that face."**

**"What?"**

**"That face."**
**"We're standing."**
**"All five of us."**
**"That's the result."**

He tries to smile.

It hurts to see him trying.

Taera walks beside you.

**"Scars stay."** she says.
**"That's normal."**
**"It means something real happened."**

Ikar says nothing the whole way down.

At the foot of the volcano, he stops.

He looks at you.

He rests his hand on your shoulder.

One second.

He takes it away.

He keeps walking.

That is his way of forgiving.

You know it.

Now you know it.

taera_main_refusee.title: Stepping Back
taera_main_refusee.text:
You step back.

Taera moves forward again.

**"{{player}}."**

The Chaos explodes.

She is thrown.

Ikar shouts her name.

He runs.

He catches her.

He holds her in his arms.

He looks at you.

No anger.

Something worse.

Pain.

Aryn shouts something.
Vael shouts something.

The Chaos no longer hears them.

The Chaos no longer hears anything.

And you —

You just watch.

Taera's hand.

Still outstretched.

Even on the ground.

She is still reaching out.

chaos_deborde.title: The Overflow
chaos_deborde.text:
The Chaos pours out entirely.

There is no more inside.
No more outside.

Just the Chaos.

The four are there.

Ikar holding Taera.
Aryn in front of them.
Vael materializing between you and the others.

A bulwark.

The Chaos passes through them.

Not to kill them.

To pass.

Beyond the platform.
Beyond the volcano.
Toward Aerith.

Toward everything.

un_moment.title: A Moment
un_moment.text:
There is one moment.

Just one.

Where you see their faces.

Ikar, who does not strike.
Who cannot.
Who made that choice.

Aryn, whose eyes say:
*I knew it wasn't your fault.*

Vael, still searching for a joke.
To give you a way out.
A door.
Something.

Taera, whose hand is still outstretched.

Still.

Even now.

That moment lasts a second.

An eternity.

And then the Chaos moves on again.

And you with it.

fin_chaos_regne.title: Ending — What We Leave Behind
fin_chaos_regne.text:
Aerith bears the scars.

The cities rebuild.
People remember.
Children learn the new legend.

There is a new statue in Aurenthal.

Not of you.

Of the four.

Ikar holding Taera.
Aryn in front of them.
Vael between them and the Chaos.

*They held on until the end.*

That is what is carved on it.

Not their victories.

Their way of staying.

Somewhere — no one knows where —

A seed is sprouting in the rock of a volcano.

No one has understood how.

It is there all the same.

verite_conversations.title: What They Really Said
verite_conversations.text:
You go down slowly.

You stop.

**"I heard your conversations."**

They all stop.

**"From the beginning."**

Silence.

Aryn turns around.

**"We know."**

**"Then tell me what it meant."**

choices.text: "Ready for anything" — what did that mean?
"And if we're wrong" — wrong about what?

explication_pret_a_tout.title: Ready for Anything
explication_pret_a_tout.text:
Ikar answers.

Without hesitation.

**"The spirits have been telling us that since we were ten."**
**"Ready for anything."**

**"And I understood that it meant..."**

**"...to kill me if necessary."** you finish.

**"Yes."**

He looks at you.

**"For a long time I believed that was it."**
**"That this was my role."**
**"The ultimate option."**

**"And the night in the camp..."**

**"I had decided."** he says.
**"Before I even knew you."**
**"I had decided that if the Chaos became too strong..."**

He stops.

**"And after?"**

**"After, I saw you."**
**"A kid who wanted to protect his village."**
**"Who lost everything trying."**

He looks at his hands.

**"It wasn't the same anymore."**

Aryn rests her hand on his shoulder.

**"Being ready for all that didn't mean killing."** she says.
**"It meant being ready to give up everything we have."**
**"Even our certainty that we were right."**

Ikar looks up.

**"It took me a while to understand."**

explication_erreurs.title: The Same Mistakes
explication_erreurs.text:
Aryn answers this time.

**"The elders made a mistake with Caël."**

**"Which one?"**

**"They tried to kill him first."**
**"Before reaching out."**
**"And when they finally reached out..."**
**"...it was too late for them."**
**"Caël had closed himself off."**
**"But they died anyway."**
**"Because they had waited too long."**

**"So the same mistakes were..."**

**"Waiting."** she says.
**"And treating the Chaos as a threat first."**
**"Before treating it as a person."**

Ikar crosses his arms.

**"I didn't agree."**

**"I know."** Aryn says.
**"That's why we kept arguing."**

**"You were arguing about me."**

**"For you."** Taera says.
**"Not against you."**
**"It's different."**

choices.text: "And if we're wrong" — wrong about what?

explication_tort.title: What If We Are Wrong
explication_tort.text:
**"And if we're wrong — what was that question about?"**

Ikar answers.

**"Wrong to trust you."**

**"You thought I was going to destroy everything."**

**"Yes."**

He does not try to soften it.

**"And Aryn?"**

**"I thought we were wrong not to trust you."**
**"That the real mistake was to start over, like with Caël."**
**"To treat the Chaos as a threat."**
**"Before treating the person as a person."**

**"You didn't agree."**

**"No."** Aryn says.
**"We rarely do."**

Vael raises his hand.

**"I had an opinion."**

**"Which one?"** Ikar asks.

**"That you were both right."**
**"And that the real question wasn't right or wrong."**
**"It was — are we here."**

He shrugs.

**"We were here."**
**"Result."**

explication_final.title: Trusting Him
explication_final.text:
**"One last thing."**

They wait.

**"'Trust him.'"**
**"I heard that too."**

Aryn smiles.

Not much.

But truly.

**"That was me."** she says.
**"Ikar asked what to do if things went wrong."**
**"If the Chaos took over completely."**

**"And you said to trust him."**

**"Yes."**

**"Even in that case."**

**"Especially in that case."**

Long silence.

Taera steps closer.

She takes your hand.

The same hand as on the summit.

**"Do you see now?"**

**"What you were saying."**

**"Yes."**

**"And what we meant."**

You look at the black blade.

It absorbs the evening light.

Cold.

As always.

**"Thank you."** you say.

Not enough.

But it is a beginning.
